events.description:
Think you can spell out the perfect end to your quarter? The Association for Computing Education (ACE) is wrapping up the quarter with our first-ever Computing Bee.

To unwind right before dead week, we are putting together a fun computing education twist on the classic spelling bee. You and a group will team up to compete in a thrilling series of computing-themed games, earning points along the way to win some awesome prizes. Prizes will range from squish toys and goodie bags, all the way up to the ultimate prize: getting to pie our ACE President, Nichole!

So whether you are yearning for the title of first place, want to participate in some fun games, or simply want to destress from exams, come take a break and join us for plenty of snacks, drinks, prizes, and fun! Everyone is welcome!

📅 Date: Tuesday, December 1st
🕔 Time: 4:00 PM to 6:30 PM
📍 Location: Gates Common (CSE1 691)
*Please remember to RSVP at the link in our bio!*

- ACE Officers

If you have any questions or concerns, please don’t hesitate to contact us at ace-officers@cs.washington.edu. ACE is committed to providing access, equal opportunity, and reasonable accommodation for our events, programs, activities, and education for individuals with disabilities (with advance notice). Please reach out to Linda Taing, Senior Student Leadership Development Specialist, directly at lindavt@cs.washington.edu if you have any questions or requests.

events.title: Emerald City Card Show by WGA - UW Seattle
events.description:
Emerald City Card Show – UW Seattle presented by the Washington Gaming Association at UW is bringing the ultimate collector experience to the heart of campus! Join us at the UW Husky Union Building (HUB) Ballrooms (2nd Floor) for a full day of buying, selling, trading, and connecting with the PNW community. This is a show built by collectors, for collectors.
Browse 145+ vendor tables featuring Pokémon, Magic: The Gathering, sports cards, Riftbound, custom art, handcrafted items, sealed products, slabs, accessories, and more. Whether you’re a student hobbyist, a seasoned collector, or brand new to the game, there’s something for everyone.
What to expect:
Massive Variety: A wide selection of trusted vendors, local artists, and exclusive finds.
Trade-Friendly Environment: Bring your trade binders and find your next grail!
VIP Early Entry: Get in at 10:00 AM — two hours before general admission—to get first dibs on the best inventory and be entered into our raffle for dozens of prizes!
Accessible Location: Located right in the heart of campus in the spacious 2nd Floor Ballrooms.
Location: UW Husky Union Building (HUB)
Room: Ballrooms, 2nd Floor East Stevens Way Northeast, Seattle, WA
